system.description:
You strike with your weapon as a feint, then use it as an anchor, striking the ground followed by an upper strike to an enemies torso that is followed by a downward strike, driving them to the ground.

Make two melee Taijutsu attacks against a creature you can see. The first attack deals your [Weapon Damage], and the second attack dealing your [Unarmed Damage] + 1d6.

Chain 1: If you score a hit with both attacks, the affected creature must make a Dexterity or Constitution saving throw, being knocked Off-Guard on a failed save until the end of your next turn.

Chain 2: If you score a hit with at least one attack, the affected creature must make a Strength or Intelligence saving throw being knocked Off-Guard on a failed save until the end of your next turn.

Off-Guard. An off-guard creature that takes damage from this jutsu has the Off-Guard condition extended until the end of your next turn.

At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above D-Rank, increase the cost of this jutsu by 3 and damage by 1d6 for each attack. If this jutsu is cast at B-Rank or higher, you can make one additional melee Taijutsu attack, dealing your [Weapon Damage] + [Unarmed Damage].
